protocol.parent_evidence: Unvalidated PPO200 circle1/15 development successes; no full-scope acceptance.
protocol.method: At actual local-policy states,20 fixed +/-forward/turn action perturbations generate simulator-only short returns. Subsequent branch actions use frozen ordinary local actor and its correctly advanced private hidden state. Differentiate team mean discounted reward by central differences, transform to left/right derivatives, clip to[-1,1], normalize batch RMS and take one recurrent actor-gradient step per rollout. No argmax expert action labels.
protocol.budget: Both arms share actual-state/optimizer budgets; horizon5 uses up to5x counterfactual simulator controls. Count actual and all branch controls separately. Stop branch return at time limit. No computation-efficiency claim.
protocol.boundary: Full simulator snapshots are training infrastructure. Actor forward sees only local9/task4/privateGRU64; no snapshot coordinates, identities, visibility, fitted target or branch gradient is an input/mask/runtime controller. All5 circle robots are learned; zero command columns/moments persist. Critic is unused compatibility storage; log_std is unused and unchanged by deterministic training.

reference.title: Deterministic Policy Gradient Algorithms, Silver et al.,2014
reference.use: Motivates the actor chain rule through an action-value gradient. This custom finite-horizon simulator difference method is a biased approximation, not a reproduction or convergence guarantee for the paper's off-policy actor-critic.

protocol.selection: Only exact final80 candidates, deterministic same15 development worlds and original numeric gates. Require>=14/15 official successes AND final holds with zero total safety attempts. Intermediate20 diagnostic only. No extension or default promotion; prefer horizon1 if both pass.
protocol.scope: Exploratory circle-only reward-based recurrent actor optimization, not PPO. Common BCseed11 and prior PPOseed23 initializer, new finite-update seed47; not independent full training pipelines, final-heldout or four-task/memory/switching/device acceptance. HypotheticalFOV60 and central-square initial sampler remain assumptions.
